The '''Resistance''' was a guerrilla group which battled the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] after they [[Battle of Garqi|invaded]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. [[Rade Dromath]] was the group's leader.<ref name="Ruin" />
